title: Fixed Funnel and Alternating Open Trough Ball Run
description: One newly authored complete empty tabletop gravity-ball-run appearance. Two grounded full side posts and a rear cross header carry three separate full-length thick open U troughs, alternating slope direction. Each low end has a real open falling mouth positioned above the next higher receiving end, and each upper end has a complete raised stop. A true open tapered top funnel with a hollow neck is carried by its full annular collar and rear bracket. A lower broad open collection tray sits between the complete frame shoes. Every trough has two real underside carriers rooted into the rear frame; there are no painted tracks, closed false bores or extracted pieces of old assets. The supported alternating open channels and funnel are not an upright peg-drop field with more pins, nor a scaled continuous human spiral slide. One whole prop, zero scenes. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up, full XY envelope centred and two finite ground shoes. Empty fixed visual display only: no ball supplied, no rolling dynamics, transfer success, speed, puzzle logic, child suitability, manufacture or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
